text.about.10:
I'm a forward deployed engineer at TrustPixel. Before that I co-founded Aventos, an AI anime studio, after a few years doing various startups ventures. I've done everything from sales, GTM, engineering(self taught engineer) and a stint on the VC side doing due diligence

As an fde, I lean heavier towards the sales and marketing side, but I still code **without AI** sometimes.
text.about.28: AI anime studio. We were taking popular Korean Intellectual Property and turning them into anime using AI. I owned the full stack of building it: acquiring IP, directing, editing, coding our internal tools, marketing our show and negotiating IP deals with Korean publishers. Landed a publisher deal that's has 98.5M views in Korea, a distribution deal with BlueBox.tv, and turned our internal tooling into a platform with its first $10K in revenue.
text.about.31: AEO/LLM citation tracker which tracks how well a brand shows up when people ask ChatGPT or Claude AI questions about brand discoverability. Built the full tech stack solo and took it 0 to 1 in B2B SaaS sales.
text.about.37: Wrote and reviewed due diligence reports across an industry-agnostic portfolio — healthcare, SaaS, deep tech — for an angel syndicate and small vc fund
text.about.40: Due diligence on healthcare companies at a 1bn+ AUM medtech fund. Learned cap tables and deal analysis.
text.about.54: Work builds (Seedance tool, Manhwa Reader, client sites). I also make fun projects like this @projects.jimsonyang.com — like a soundboard app to play on calls, my custom dropbox version, and mobile apps that turned SF into a board game
text.projects.5: These are things I've built mainly for work
text.projects.8: Brands/companies will show up on chatgpt/claude. Consumers will base their decision on what AI recommends them, and understanding where and how these brands show up was a tool I've built. Built the first production app and the whole crawler pipeline to show the dashboard.
text.projects.14: Internal tool for the production team to generate, review, and archive AI video through BytePlus Seedance. Our entire workflow relies on generating, planning, and editing videos in a timeline manner. Initially used for interanl tools, we then were selling this as a platform.
text.projects.20: A reader built to make sense of messy manhwa file collections -inconsistent folder names, out-of-order chapters, mixed image formats -and put them in a nice ui to read on your phone.
text.projects.25: Tableu is data visualization software, it's incredibly complicated and we were building a complex AI agent that could generate up the visuals for you
text.projects.29: Little things I build for myself: sometimes they're half finished, often they're personal, and almost always 'what if I build X' type of thoughts
text.projects.31: This is the site where I host all my personal projects
text.projects.35: What if during a phone call you can have sound effects. Specifically meme sound effects like a vine boom, or an anime girl saying 'ahhh'. This was a 'I thought it would be funny to build and show to my friends' type of idea. And yes it was very funny to use a vine boom during a conversation
text.projects.41: I needed to backup some files and not pay for google photos. So I put a wrapper on a service called backblaze which had great pricing to back up some of my precious photos and memory
